scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.format:web: bun run --filter @resume-builder/ui format && bun run --filter apps-web format && bun run --filter apps-desktop format
scripts.lint:web: bun run --filter @resume-builder/ui lint && bun run --filter apps-web lint && bun run --filter apps-desktop lint
scripts.typecheck:web: bun run --filter @resume-builder/ui typecheck && bun run --filter apps-desktop typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:api && bun run test:web
scripts.verify: bun run format:web && bun run lint:web && bun run typecheck:web && bun run format:api && bun run lint:api && bun run typecheck:api
scripts.build:desktop: bun run build:web && bun run --filter apps-desktop build
scripts.dev:desktop: bun run build:desktop && bun run --filter apps-desktop start
